patch_description: The metrics show that assigning every partition the single cheapest path (baseline, total_cost 1035.14) outperforms rotating partitions across alternative candidate paths (1051.52). So the crossover keeps the baseline's cost-optimal routing strategy (all partitions use the shortest path per destination), while adopting the better implementation pattern from the other script: pre-computing all shortest paths once with `nx.single_source_dijkstra` instead of running Dijkstra per destination, and adding robust handling of unreachable/missing destinations. This maintains identical outputs to the original but is faster and safer (no crash on disconnected nodes, which protects the success rate).
